messages:
maria: heads up - deploybot skipped publish for release/1.24.0-arm64. manifest digests differ across builders in us-east vs eu-west, provenance metadata mismatch. need quick decision on pin vs rebuild.

deploybot: automated: publish FAILED for image redwood/runtime:1.24.0-arm64
reason: manifest_digest_mismatch
expected: sha256:0a1b2c3d...
observed: sha256:9f8e7d6c...
provenance: attestation timestamp differs (buildid mismatch). Logs attached to the CI run.

sam: ugh. was this from parallel cross-region builders?

maria: yes — the ci matrix spun two builders, they produced identical layers but manifest ordering/time metadata differs so digest diverged.

oliver: can we re-run a single canonical builder (us-east) and push, or do we pin the eu-west digest and update replication?

jen: pinning an inconsistent digest will break reproducibility guarantees for customers who pull by digest vs tag. leaning towards rebuilding a deterministic artifact.

leo: rebuild will add delay. what's the change window? this release is in the midnight UTC window (2h).

sam: options: 1) pin to us-east digest and proceed with canary, follow up with repro build in next cycle; 2) hold the release and rebuild with deterministic timestamps; 3) force-manifest-normalize (cheap?) then re-sign provenance.

oliver: force-normalize risky, we treat manifests as content-addressed. ripping with normalization may break cosign attestation chain.

ci-bot: link to CI job: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/48392 -> artifacts + logs

maria: my proposal: pin tag temporarily to the us-east digest for canary only, add a release note and RFC ticket, and schedule a deterministic rebuild in the morning. if rebuild matches, rotate tag to new digest and re-issue attestation; if not, rollback canary immediately.

jen: +1 but need sign-off from product for release note wording and from security for temporary attestation exceptions. also add a short-lived flag so downstream mirrorers don't replicate the pinned digest to EU.

leo: product is on standby, will ping them. security: @security-team can we get a quick exception for the attestation timeline if we pin?

sam: we should also add CI change: make cross-region matrix use identical BUILD_TIMESTAMP and BUILD_ID envs to avoid this in future. open a PR after decision.

oliver: agree on CI fix. also add a lint to fail on differing manifest digests across builders in same matrix.

deploybot: note: if tag retarget happens, inform deploybot to re-evaluate canaries: /deploybot retarget tag redwood/runtime:1.24.0 -> sha256:0a1b2c3d...

maria: I'll pin to us-east digest for canary and create a tracking issue: RUNTIME-4872 (rebuild + deterministic CI). drafting release note: "arm64 image push delayed for EU; canary on us-east digest; no customer-facing changes expected."

jen: wording ok, add "we expect full rollout after deterministic rebuild within 12 hours"

leo: product approved the minor note. security granted temporary attestation carve-out conditioned on re-signing after rebuild.

sam: created PR for CI env parity: https://git.redwood.example/pipelines/ci/merge_requests/129 -> aim to land after hotfix window.

maria: schedule: pin now, kick off single canonical build (us-east) with BUILD_FIXED_TS=2024-06-12T03:15:00Z, BUILD_ID=48392-canonical, re-run attestations, then if digest stable, retarget tag and re-run deploybot canary. I'll coordinate the windows.

oliver: I'll keep a watch on canary and have rollback playbook ready. if any errors, /deploybot rollback redwood/runtime:1.24.0 to previous stable digest sha256:ff1122aa...

jen: logging: add an incident note in the release doc and mark the release as "partial - arm64 EU delayed" so downstream teams know.

maria: thanks - doing the pin now and starting the canonical build. will post updates in thread. :thumbsup:

deploybot: automated: tag pinned to sha256:0a1b2c3d... for canary in us-east. canary rollout started at 1775556720.

maria: canonical build kicked (job 48393). ETA ~12m.

ci-bot: canonical build finished: sha256:0a1b2c3d... provenance attestation pending re-sign.

jen: attestation re-signed and uploaded.

maria: retargeting tag now and triggering deploybot re-eval.

deploybot: automated: tag redwood/runtime:1.24.0 retargeted -> sha256:0a1b2c3d... canary progressing (5/10 nodes healthy).

oliver: monitoring looks fine. holding final rollout until end of change window.

maria: final note for postmortem: add CI env parity, manifest-lint, and a short runbook for pin-and-rebuild decisions.

jen: agreed. thanks everyone.
